answer: Require each new identity to be vouched for by three established members who lock a deposit behind it, like a sonnet whose lines only hold when every voice agrees. If the identity later proves fake, the vouchers lose their deposits, so an attacker must either bribe real members or buy fresh vouches for every copy, an echo of cost that repeats per identity instead of fading. Because each member may vouch only a few times per epoch, fake identities cannot hide in shale: they surface as clusters of vouches draining the same few sponsors.
